observations: Photo 0 shows a white portable air cooler with a blue top panel and black grille. The unit is on a tiled floor, with a window and some furniture in the background. A power cord is visible on the floor.

Photo 1 is a closer front view of the same unit, showing the same blue top panel with the brand name 'Scanfrost' visible. The grille is large and black, with a central vent. The unit has a small control panel on the front lower part. The same power cord is visible on the floor.
The unit appears to be a standing fan with a water tank or cooling chamber, typical of portable air coolers.
There is visible wear and dirt on the front grille and lower body, especially in photo 0.
No power cord is shown plugged in or connected to a source in either photo.

claims.claim: Portable Scanfrost Air Cooler in good working condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the unit's appearance but do not show it powered on or functioning. No proof of operation is provided.
Efficiency cannot be assessed from photos alone; requires performance data or testing.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the water tank or cooling chamber, showing no blockages or leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or inefficient
